The most likely corrupted element is the pass device **Mp**. Its sensitivity (+688% for a 20% change) dwarfs every other element's effect on the failing PSRR spec, and its operating point is inconsistent with a healthy regulator: it sits in triode (Vds = 0.624 V < Vdsat = 0.689 V) with gate pulled to about 0.08 V, and its L = 0.19 µm is at the short-channel edge for a pass device. A wrong W or L on Mp would explain the collapsed PSRR. I haven't verified this by re-simulating, so the ranking rests on the sensitivities and operating points.

The short channel and width leave it in triode with the error amp driving its gate near ground, which collapses output impedance and PSRR at 1 kHz. Restore Mp to its intended W/L so it operates in saturation with adequate Vds-Vdsat headroom."}
